rawFindings.title: Incorrect class name string in v1 encoder.js leading to potential wrong type check
rawFindings.explanation: The condition comparing obj.$class to 'java.utils.HashMap' is incorrect because the correct package name is 'java.util.HashMap'. This mistake causes the check to fail and might result in improper serialization behavior for HashMap class instances.
rawFindings.suggestion: Fix the condition to compare obj.$class to 'java.util.HashMap' instead of 'java.utils.HashMap'.

rawFindings.title: Undefined reference to javaObject.DEFAULT_CLASSNAME.map in encoder.js
rawFindings.explanation: The code compares obj.$class to javaObject.DEFAULT_CLASSNAME.map, but from the repository context we see exports.DEFAULT_CLASSNAME uses 'iMap' as the key for 'java.util.Map'. The identifier 'map' is not defined, likely causing a runtime error or always false condition.
rawFindings.suggestion: Replace javaObject.DEFAULT_CLASSNAME.map with javaObject.DEFAULT_CLASSNAME.iMap on line 331 to ensure proper comparison.
